# 4 Ezra Chapter 2 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 2:9 — description of Sodom and Gomorrah's aftermath

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "heaps of ashes" | Literal rendering of Latin cinis |
| LOGOS | "mounds of ashes" | Slight variation for flow |
| PNEUMA | "tar and ash to this day" | Paraphrase with added contemporary reference |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Mounds of ashes" (LOGOS). PNEUMA's "to this day" is an addition beyond the Latin.

---

## 2:12 — tree of life description

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "as a fragrant-perfume to them" | Literal with hyphenated compound |
| LOGOS | "as a sweet fragrance to them" | Adds "sweet" for natural English |
| PNEUMA | "will be their perfume" | Shortens for directness |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "As a sweet fragrance to them" (LOGOS). The additional modifier improves the English.

---

## 2:21 — "protect the maimed" vs. "protect the crippled"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "protect the maimed" | Literal (Latin truncos) |
| LOGOS | "protect the crippled" | More accessible modern term |
| PNEUMA | "take care of the disabled" | Modern but loses specificity |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Protect the crippled" (LOGOS). Accessible without losing the physical specificity of truncos.

---

## 2:43 — young man's stature

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "of great stature, taller than all others" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "of great stature, taller than all the rest" | Same with minor variation |
| PNEUMA | "of extraordinary height — taller than anyone else" | More vivid |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Of great stature, taller than all the rest" (LOGOS). Preserves the escalation implicit in the Latin.

---

## 2:47 — "Son of God" identification

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "He-is the Son of-God" | Literal hyphenated |
| LOGOS | "He is the Son of God" | Standard |
| PNEUMA | "He is the Son of God" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Unanimous on "Son of God" — key Christological title preserved exactly.

---

## Total disagreements: 5
